summary: Compact Lens scoped filters and apply them immediately: each section or card shows one Filters trigger with an override count and chips instead of two always-open filter rows, and the effective-context line appears only when it differs from the dashboard or carries a notice. Choosing a period, the inherited period, a facet selection or Restore now applies at once (the separate Apply button and its staged notice are gone), focus returns to the operated control, and context actions share the filter-trigger height. Runtime keys: adds filter.context.local and filter.context.card, removes filter.context.apply and filter.context.staged.
